description: This file defines the HomeActivity class for an Android application, which displays a searchable list of products, manages navigation to authentication, cart, and product detail screens, and handles user interactions such as searching and item selection.

classes.name: HomeActivity
classes.description: An activity displaying a list of products with search functionality and navigation options.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up views, and loads products.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections for navigation.

methods.name: debounceSearch
methods.description: Implements debounce to delay search execution.

methods.name: loadProducts
methods.description: Fetches and displays products based on search query.

methods.name: openProduct
methods.description: Opens product detail activity with selected product information.
